post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

- The last standalone public annual report filed by the registrant was its Form 10-K for
  fiscal year 2012, filed February 21, 2013; no Form 10-K or 20-F was filed by the registrant
  in the ~2015–2017 outcome window. [SRC: SEC accession 0000865754-13-000005, Form 10-K filed 2013-02-21]

  (a Denmark corporation, "Parent") and Danfoss Acquisition, Inc. (a Delaware wholly owned
  subsidiary of Parent), under which Merger Sub would commence a tender offer to acquire all
  Company common stock not already owned by the Danfoss group at $58.50 per share in cash;
  the Danfoss group already owned approximately 75.6% of the outstanding shares. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-13-017298, Form 8-K Item 1.01 filed 2013-03-05]

  April 12, 2013 at 11:53 a.m., with the Company surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of
  Danfoss A/S; the aggregate value of the merger was stated to be approximately $700 million,
  and the Company requested suspension of NYSE trading and the delisting and deregistration
  of its common stock. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-13-030377, Form 8-K Items 2.01/3.01 filed 2013-04-17]

  reporting obligations. [SRC: SEC accession 0000876661-13-000206, Form 25-NSE filed 2013-04-15] [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-13-034192, Form 15-12B filed 2013-04-29]

- Because the registrant was acquired outright and deregistered in April 2013, there is no
  public audited financial statement, annual report, or other periodic disclosure for the
  registrant covering the ~2015–2017 outcome window; consequently the realized post-deal
  scalar (revenue, income, impairment, divestiture, or other trajectory measure) for the
  business is NOT publicly observable for that window, and the outcome is coded UNCERTAIN.
  [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-13-034192, Form 15-12B filed 2013-04-29]
- No documented disruption or continuity at the product/process or process/organization
  interface can be sourced for the outcome window, because the acquirer (a foreign private
  issuer's parent group) did not separately disclose the acquired business's or the joint
  venture's trajectory in any public U.S. filing retrievable for this entity. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- The registrant's public record ends in 2013: after Danfoss A/S completed an approximately
  $700 million tender-offer/short-form merger (effective April 12, 2013) and the Company
  deregistered (Form 15-12B, April 29, 2013), no standalone public reporting exists for the
  ~2015–2017 window. The realized 3–5-year outcome for the business and the joint venture is
  therefore UNCERTAIN (no public record); it is not fabricated or inferred from any parent's
  consolidated results. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-13-030377, Form 8-K filed 2013-04-17] [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-13-034192, Form 15-12B filed 2013-04-29]

[SLICE END]
